title: ENGINE WIRING
summary: Engine wiring harness routing on the firewall/left fender area and at the starter: harness clipped to the body with rivet-on clips, wires to the coil, TCS (transmission controlled spark) solenoid and switch, horn relay and the front junction block. At the starter solenoid the battery cable and harness leads go on the studs with lock washers and nuts; the harness connector bolts to the junction block. Related: TCS switch on UPC 7.

fastening.note: Clip [2] is riveted [1] to the body and holds the harness [3]; shown at four places along the harness (near the wiper motor, firewall, and above the junction block).
Clip [4] riveted [1] to the body beside the coil, holding the harness [3].

fastening.to: heater attaching nut / stud on the firewall
fastening.note: Clip [5] holds the harness under the heater attaching nut (HTR ATT. NUT).
View A: harness 12 RPL lead goes on the solenoid terminal stud, then lock washer [6] and nut [7].
View A: purple/yellow (20Y, IGN) lead terminal held by lock washer [6] and nut [8].
Note B: harness lead secured with the nut on the coil positive (+) post.
Harness connector (existing part, half-black square) is fastened to the junction block with a bolt/screw; generator & front lamp harness connector is mated to it first.

notes: A: Press boot over switch asm.
NOTE: Assemble generator & fwd lamp connector to engine harness connector before assembling to junc block.
